publishedDeadlines.label: International fall admission
publishedDeadlines.note: Central policy requires application complete and acceptance by this date before fall; no year stated.

english.note: If English is not primary language. Alternatives PTE55 or iTEP3.9. Foreign academic records require NACES-member evaluation.

requirements.note: B.S. or M.S. in biomedical-sciences-related field, GPA minimum 3.0; research preferred. Must submit GRE300 combined verbal/quantitative OR MCAT60th percentile OR conferred M.S. GPA3.0. Statement must discuss personal background, motivation, career goals, Christian commitment and views on origins. Three faculty/professional letters require physical signatures and email submission. Application fee deferred until enrollment; amount and waiver not established.

funding.note: Graduate assistantship opportunities may provide a full-time tuition scholarship. International applicants may seek GSA openings; no universal appointment or living stipend guarantee stated.
